title: Science Atlas Chemistry Labs — Classes 1–12
coverageNote: A 270-investigation development catalogue. Class placement is editorial, not certified board alignment. A listed lab is not counted implemented until its review fields pass.

labs.title: Sort objects by their material
labs.aim: Sort objects by their material. Record the observations and explain the evidence.

labs.title: Compare transparent, translucent and opaque materials
labs.aim: Compare transparent, translucent and opaque materials. Record the observations and explain the evidence.
labs.modelAssumptions: Illustrative narrowband slab, chosen coefficients, forward-scattering approximation; no calibrated optical material constants or full transport solver.

labs.title: Find waterproof materials
labs.aim: Find waterproof materials. Record the observations and explain the evidence.
labs.modelAssumptions: Chosen sheet conductance and wetting delay; reservoir head model. No capillary, absorption, swelling or sheet-failure solver.

labs.title: Compare water absorption by paper, cloth and plastic
labs.aim: Compare water absorption by paper, cloth and plastic. Record the observations and explain the evidence.
labs.modelAssumptions: Chosen first-order retained-water model; capped by available water; density approximation 1 g/mL; same short draining protocol. No swelling, evaporation, dissolution or surface-droplet solver.

labs.title: Sort rough and smooth surfaces
labs.aim: Sort rough and smooth surfaces. Record the observations and explain the evidence.
labs.modelAssumptions: Synthetic height fields and sampled mean absolute profile deviation; not measured material data, tactile sensation, friction prediction or standards-compliant metrology.

labs.title: Compare flexible and rigid objects
labs.aim: Compare flexible and rigid objects. Record the observations and explain the evidence.
labs.modelAssumptions: Chosen small-deflection Euler–Bernoulli cantilever examples; incremental bending relative to unloaded reference, ideal clamp, no creep, yielding or dynamics.
